definitions.presence: Registration is matched by audited aliases/domains and the exact recorded row. Active registration does not establish a working endpoint.
definitions.endpoints: Officially declared candidate addresses need current robots/XML and Oracle validation before adoption. No candidate was installed or initialized.
definitions.recorded_health: Most recent checksum-verified collection evidence through the saved snapshot. recorded_collection_counts summarize matched addresses including pending attribution-review cases, not confirmed publisher coverage. registered_active_collection_counts exclude needs_review anchors. Successful XML can contain zero new URLs. Indexes are not article URL streams; no live check or outage adjudication was made.
definitions.coverage: The denominator is the selected anchor list, not all major publishers. Country placement can reflect editorial coverage rather than company headquarters and requires review before changes.
